title: Senior Lecturer of Business Administration
bio: This Short Intensive Program (SIP) is designed for MBA students interested in pursuing Product Management summer internships or full time positions at leading technology companies. Through targeted case discussions and engagement with senior product leaders, students examine how hiring managers assess core PM competencies including analytics, product craft, product strategy, business acumen, monetization, and AI. The program also includes resume feedback, career coaching, and individual advising. As a capstone, each student completes a series of mock interviews with experienced PMs and receives detailed, personalized feedback.
